summary: Tool steps work on your own Azure model.

improvements: Your agent's tool steps (memory, mail, calendar, files) run on your own Azure OpenAI model, as they do on Gemini.
fixes: A tool result that carries a date no longer ends the answer with an error.
A tool with a long name no longer makes your model refuse the whole turn.
security: When an answer must not use tools (a consent decision), your own model is told so too.
A model's private reasoning never reaches another provider as something your agent said.
